description: One store holds everything and components select slices (Redux Toolkit, Zustand).
Small independent units composed into a graph (Jotai). Granularity comes from the graph itself.
Proxies record which properties a component read and re-render it only when those change (MobX, Valtio).
Changes are named events processed by reducers or machines (Redux, XState), which makes them loggable and replayable.
On the server, create stores per request and pass them through context; module singletons would leak data between users.
